scenarios.upstreamTest: none > should keep the current zoom and only center the target
scenarios.notes: Excalidraw scroll is world-offset, the same convention as camera.qnt (screen = (world + t) * zoom), so scrollX maps to tx. scroll = viewport / 2 / zoom - centre = 100 / 2 / 0.5 - 1025 = -925. Upstream uses toBeCloseTo on doubles; the fixed-point camera (zoom / 4096, t / 256) is exact here. fit 'none' is the centre-on-a-point goal of request_tween.

scenarios.upstreamTest: scale-down animated > should stop ticking and settle on the target once complete
scenarios.notes: Ported by intent: a finished tween removes itself and leaves the camera ON the target; further frames never move it (camera.qnt: RestIsOnTarget, a tick at rest is a no-op). The same goal with reduced motion (animation: false) must end in the identical camera. Fit-to-bounds itself is not modelled in camera.qnt (adapter policy); the target is whatever the host computes.
